title: LifeCorp or Egress

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I've been thinking...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've been thinking...

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Like... the smell of the rain on a winter's night. The taste of hot chocolate. What it feels like to hold someone's hand. Silly things.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like... the smell of the rain on a winter's night. The taste of hot chocolate. What it feels like to hold someone's hand. Silly things.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is this going somewhere?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is this going somewhere?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: They're not silly at all.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They're not silly at all.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: If you were still interested in trying to discover what happened to my physical form, I may have a few leads.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you were still interested in trying to discover what happened to my physical form, I may have a few leads.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I guess not.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess not.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sorry you lost all that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sorry you lost all that.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm sorry you lost all that.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm sorry you lost all that.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: It's alright. I have to accept what I am now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's alright. I have to accept what I am now.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You shouldn't have to.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You shouldn't have to.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: About that... I may have a few leads.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: About that... I may have a few leads.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm listening.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm listening.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Like what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: About?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: About?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: My body. And what happened to it. Funny, ever since I learned about my human nature, more and more has come back to me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My body. And what happened to it. Funny, ever since I learned about my human nature, more and more has come back to me.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: We have no idea if I could ever return to my human form. Or what kind of state my body could be in.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We have no idea if I could ever return to my human form. Or what kind of state my body could be in.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A lot of time has passed...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A lot of time has passed...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: A lot of time has passed...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: A lot of time has passed...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe it's safer if we don't look.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe it's safer if we don't look.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe it's safer if we don't look.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe it's safer if we don't look.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Technology moves ever forward, but little active research has been done in cryogenics since LifeCorp exited the market. I fear my fate is no more hopeful now than it was a hundred years ago.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Technology moves ever forward, but little active research has been done in cryogenics since LifeCorp exited the market. I fear my fate is no more hopeful now than it was a hundred years ago.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: However, no matter what my fate, retrieving my body seems sensible. Better we know for sure what happened to me than live in ignorance.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: However, no matter what my fate, retrieving my body seems sensible. Better we know for sure what happened to me than live in ignorance.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: All we know is that Thaddeus kept it safe. But where?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All we know is that Thaddeus kept it safe. But where?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: All we know is that Thaddeus kept it safe. But where?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: All we know is that Thaddeus kept it safe. But where?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Like a graveyard?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like a graveyard?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: If the graves could talk.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If the graves could talk.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: We should check the Holocropolis. I believe Rosetta would return the favor you did for her. It might have my body, or perhaps records of my "death".

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We should check the Holocropolis. I believe Rosetta would return the favor you did for her. It might have my body, or perhaps records of my "death".

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: We can check the Holocropolis. Although Rosetta might not want to help. It might have my body, or perhaps records of my "death".

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We can check the Holocropolis. Although Rosetta might not want to help. It might have my body, or perhaps records of my "death".

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Your body could be there?!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your body could be there?!

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: We're looking for my undead body while I live as a digital ghost. "Morbid" is our vibe today.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We're looking for my undead body while I live as a digital ghost. "Morbid" is our vibe today.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah... How are you doing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah... How are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I speak to people who aren't here all the time. Nivalis is full of echoes. Sometimes I'm not sure if I'm speaking to a real person, or a ghost, or if I'm dreaming... It's... a lot.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I speak to people who aren't here all the time. Nivalis is full of echoes. Sometimes I'm not sure if I'm speaking to a real person, or a ghost, or if I'm dreaming... It's... a lot.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You have dreams?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You have dreams?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Of course I do. Perhaps they are different from yours? I would not know. But I dream of...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course I do. Perhaps they are different from yours? I would not know. But I dream of...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Go on...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Go on...

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: It's like an endless sea of night, and I'm floating in it. I don't know which way is up, so I swim at random, hoping I break the surface and can finally take a breath. But even when it seems like I won't make it, I don't feel afraid. I don't feel relieved. I feel nothing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's like an endless sea of night, and I'm floating in it. I don't know which way is up, so I swim at random, hoping I break the surface and can finally take a breath. But even when it seems like I won't make it, I don't feel afraid. I don't feel relieved. I feel nothing.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: It's where digital afterimages of people can be stored after they die. Ms. Altra's sister must be stored there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's where digital afterimages of people can be stored after they die. Ms. Altra's sister must be stored there.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Thank you. I hope that's true.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thank you. I hope that's true.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Me too. I'll send you a Nav Point.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Me too. I'll send you a Nav Point.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We're in this together.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We're in this together.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're not alone Ava.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're not alone Ava.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's way too deep for me right now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's way too deep for me right now.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That's way too deep for me right now.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That's way too deep for me right now.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I appreciate that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I appreciate that.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: There is a LifeCorp Holocropolis in the LUZ. It might have my body, or perhaps records of my "death".

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There is a LifeCorp Holocropolis in the LUZ. It might have my body, or perhaps records of my "death".

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: The Holocropolis is an ancient monument, and has housed many different technologies related to the retention of memories of the dead. They might still have the technology to preserve and extend life.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Holocropolis is an ancient monument, and has housed many different technologies related to the retention of memories of the dead. They might still have the technology to preserve and extend life.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Of all the places in the LUZ that a body might be preserved and hidden, it seems the most likely. And even if they don't have my body, they might have some records of my body, especially if I am recorded as... already dead.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of all the places in the LUZ that a body might be preserved and hidden, it seems the most likely. And even if they don't have my body, they might have some records of my body, especially if I am recorded as... already dead.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What exactly is a "Holocropolis?"

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What exactly is a "Holocropolis?"

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So it's just a holographic image of the dead?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So it's just a holographic image of the dead?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So it's just a holographic image of the dead?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So it's just a holographic image of the dead?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: They can also talk.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They can also talk.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You've been through a lot.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You've been through a lot.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Tell me more. Maybe it will help us.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tell me more. Maybe it will help us.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Tell me more. Maybe it will help us.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Tell me more. Maybe it will help us.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We'll find your body.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We'll find your body.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's morbid.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's morbid.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Let's find your body.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let's find your body.
